title: Learning: `run_shell_command` & Multi-line Python Script Execution Issue
description: Discovered a persistent `SyntaxError: unterminated string literal` when attempting to execute multi-line Python scripts, written to temporary files via `write_file`, using `run_shell_command python3 <script_path>`. The error was reproducible even with a minimal file writing script. Further investigation revealed that executing the same Python logic as a single-line command via `python3 -c '...'` within `run_shell_command` worked correctly. This suggests an issue with how the shell interprets or passes multi-line script content to Python when the script is first created by `write_file`.
resolution_reason: Learning reviewed and incorporated into agent operational guidelines for executing Python scripts.
